Championship|U18 European Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver|[[2008 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2008 Greece]]|}} }} '''Donatas Motiejūnas''' ({{IPA|lt|dɔˈnaːtɐs moːtʲiəˈjûːnɐs}}; born September 20, 1990) is a Lithuanian professional [[basketball]] player who most recently played for [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia]] (KLS), the [[ABA League]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. He was drafted 20th overall in the [[2011 NBA draft]] by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] who traded his rights to the [[Houston Rockets]]. After spending four seasons with the Rockets from 2012 to 2016, Motiejūnas joined the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] in January 2017. In 2019, he signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]]. ==Professional career== ===Žalgiris (2005–2008)=== [[File:Diego Fajardo e Motiejūnas.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Motiejūnas (front) with [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Benetton Basket]] in 2011]] In 2005, Motiejūnas began his career playing with [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] junior team, [[Žalgiris-Arvydas Sabonis school]], who played in Lithuania's second-tier [[National Basketball League (Lithuania)|National Basketball League]]. In 2007–08, he made his debut for the senior team in a [[Baltic Basketball League]] (BBL) game against the [[ASK Riga]]. He scored 15 points in 22 minutes.{{cite web|title=Donatas Motiejūnas – Krepsinis.net|url=http://www.krepsinis.net/zaidejai/donatas-motiejunas/72303|work=Krepsinis.net|access-date=August 6, 2009|language=lt-LT}}{{cite web|title=MOTIEJUNAS, DONATAS – Euroleague.net|url=http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=LCZ|work=Euroleague.net|access-date=August 6, 2009}} ===Aisčiai (2008–2009)=== In 2008, Motiejūnas was loaned to [[LSU-Atletas|Aisčiai]] for the 2008–09 season where he went on to average 19.9 points and 7.0 rebounds in 29.3 minutes per game, and he scored a season-high 29 points in a Lithuanian League game against [[BC Nevėžis|Nevėžis]] on March 22, 2009.{{cite web|title=Donato Motiejūno sezono statistika|url=http://www.krepsinis.net/statistika/zaideju-statistika/donatas-motiejunas/592/72303|work=Krepsinis.net|access-date=August 6, 2009|language=lt-LT}} In April 2009, Motiejūnas participated in the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] and on 14 April 2009 scored 21 points for the Team World which defeated 97–89 Team USA.{{cite web |title=Pasaulio rinktinė su Motiejūnu įveikė amerikiečius |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/archyvas/pasaulio-rinktine-su-motiejunu-iveike-amerikiecius-872-36508 |website=[[15min.lt]] |date=14 April 2009 |access-date=21 March 2026 |language=lt}} ===Benetton Basket (2009–2011)=== In August 2009, Motiejūnas signed a multi-year deal with [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Benetton Basket]] of Italy's [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{cite web|title=Another great signing by Benetton: Donatas Motiejunas|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/78643/another-great-signing-by-benetton-donatas-motiejunas.html|work=Sportando.com|date=August 6, 2009|access-date=August 6, 2009}} In 33 league games in 2009–10, he averaged 9.8 points and 5.2 rebounds per game. In April 2010, Motiejūnas declared for the [[2010 NBA draft]], but later withdrew and returned to Benetton.{{cite web|title=Donatas Motiejunas has entered in NBA draft|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/80977/donatas-motiejunas-has-entered-in-nba-draft.html|work=Sportando.com|date=April 23, 2010|access-date=April 23, 2010}}{{cite web|title=Motiejunas out of NBA draft, back to Benetton|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/81809/motiejunas-out-of-nba-draft-back-to-benetton.html|work=Sportando.com|date=June 4, 2010|access-date=June 4, 2010}} He went on to win the 2011 [[EuroCup Rising Star]] award after helping Benetton reach [[ULEB Eurocup|Eurocup]]'s [[2011 Eurocup Basketball Final Four|2011 Final Four]], averaging 10.9 points and 5.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web|title=2010-11 Eurocup Rising Star Trophy winner: Donatas Motiejunas, Benetton Bwin|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/84189/2010-11-eurocup-rising-star-trophy-winner-donatas-motiejunas-benetton-bwin|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923225438/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/84189/2010-11-eurocup-rising-star-trophy-winner-donatas-motiejunas-benetton-bwin|url-status=dead|archive-date=September 23, 2015|work=EurocupBasketball.com|date=April 4, 2011|access-date=April 4, 2011}} ===Asseco Prokom (2011–2012)=== On June 23, 2011, Motiejūnas was selected with the 20th overall pick in the [[2011 NBA draft]] by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{cite web|first=Tom|last=Ziller|url=https://www.sbnation.com/nba-draft/2011/6/23/2240702/2011-nba-draft-results-donatas-motiejunas-minnesota-timberwolves|title=2011 NBA Draft Results: Donatas Motiejunas Drafted By Timberwolves With No. 20 Pick|work=SBNation.com|date=June 23, 2011|access-date=June 23, 2011}} The next day, his rights were traded, along with [[Jonny Flynn]], to the [[Houston Rockets]] in exchange for [[Brad Miller (basketball)|Brad Miller]] and the draft rights to the 23rd overall pick, [[Nikola Mirotić]].{{cite web|title=Rockets acquire guard Jonny Flynn|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/draft2011/news/story?id=6698564|work=ESPN.com|date=June 24, 2011|access-date=June 24, 2011}} Due to the [[2011 NBA lockout|NBA lockout]], Motiejūnas returned to Europe. On September 22, 2011, Benetton [[loan (sports)|loaned]] Motiejūnas to [[Asseco Gdynia|Asseco Prokom]] for the 2011–12 season.{{cite web|title=Benetton Treviso loans Motiejunas to Prokom and signs Scalabrine|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/88463/benetton-treviso-loans-motiejunas-to-prokom-and-signs-scalabrine.html|work=Sportando.com|date=September 22, 2011|access-date=September 22, 2011}}{{cite web|title=Asseco Prokom lands Eurocup Rising Star Motiejunas|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/87508/asseco-prokom-lands-eurocup-rising-star-motiejunas|work=Euroleague.net|date=September 22, 2011|access-date=September 22, 2011}} On December 7, 2011, he recorded a career-high 21 rebounds (18 defensive) against [[KK Union Olimpija|Union Olimpija]], the most defensive rebounds in a [[EuroLeague]] game [[EuroLeague records since the 2000–01 season|since the 2000–01 season]].{{cite web|title=Eurolygos rekordą pagerinęs Motiejūnas atvedė "Asseco Prokom" į pirmą pergalę (video, statistika)|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-45038-eurolygos-rekorda-pagerines-motiejunas-atvede-asseco-prokom-i-pirma-pergale-video-statistika.html|work=BasketNews.it|date=December 7, 2011|access-date=December 7, 2011|language=lt-LT}} He also helped lead Asseco Prokom to a ninth consecutive [[Polish Basketball League]] title in [[2011–12 PLK season|2011–12]]. During the seventh and final game of the finals, he recorded 23 points and 11 rebounds.{{cite web|title=Motiejūnas atvedė "Asseco Prokom" iki Lenkijos čempionų titulo|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-51288-motiejunas-atvede-asseco-prokom-iki-lenkijos-cempionu-titulo.html|work=BasketNews.it|date=June 6, 2012|access-date=June 6, 2012|language=lt-LT}} ===Houston Rockets (2012–2016)=== ====2012–13 season==== [[File:Withey shot 2013-10-05.JPG|thumb|left|200px|Motiejūnas defending [[Jeff Withey]] in October 2013]] [[File:Donatas Motiejunas and Hasheem Thabeet.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Motiejūnas versus [[Hasheem Thabeet]] in October 2012]] On July 6, 2012, Motiejūnas signed a four-year, rookie scale contract with the [[Houston Rockets]],{{cite web|title=Rockets sign center Motiejunas to multiyear deal|url=http://www.nba.com/2012/news/07/06/motiejunas-rockets.ap/index.html|work=NBA.com|date=July 6, 2012|access-date=July 6, 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120708235203/http://www.nba.com/2012/news/07/06/motiejunas-rockets.ap/index.html|archive-date=July 8, 2012}} and joined them for the 2012 [[NBA Summer League]]. In his summer league debut, he recorded 25 points, 9 rebounds, 2 assists, 2 steals and 1 block.{{cite web|first=Jason|last=Friedman|title=Summer League Diary Day One: Rockets vs. Raptors|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/summer-league-diary-day-one-rockets-vs-raptors|work=NBA.com|date=July 13, 2012|access-date=July 13, 2012}} After the game, he quoted a famous [[Lithuanian language|Lithuanian]] idiom describing his debut: "Jeigu bijai vilko – neik į mišką" (''English:'' If you're scared of wolves, do not go into the woods).{{cite web|first=Jason|last=Friedman|title=A Wolf Among Wolves|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/wolf-among-wolves|work=NBA.com|date=July 13, 2012|access-date=July 13, 2012}} Overall, he averaged 16.3 points and 7.8 rebounds in four games.{{cite web|title=2012 Summer League Statistics – Donatas Motiejunas|url=http://www.nba.com/summer-league/2012/players/sl_donatas_motiejunas/|work=NBA.com|access-date=November 14, 2012}} On November 14, 2012, Motiejūnas was assigned to Houston's [[NBA Development League]] (NBA D-League) affiliate, the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]].{{cite web|title=Rockets Launched: Houston Assigns Machado, Motiejunas to NBA D-League Affiliate Rio Grande Valley Vipers|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/houston_rockets_assign_machado_montejunas_to_rio_grande_valley_2012_11_14.html|work=NBA.com|date=November 14, 2012|access-date=November 14, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121130202459/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/houston_rockets_assign_machado_montejunas_to_rio_grande_valley_2012_11_14.html|archive-date=November 30, 2012|url-status=dead}} In his D-League debut on November 23, he recorded 31 points, 8 rebounds, 3 assists and 1 steals. Two days later, he was recalled by the Rockets.{{cite web|title=Houston Rockets recall Donatas Motiejunas from D-League|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=11520|work=InsideHoops.com|date=November 25, 2012|access-date=November 25, 2012}} He was later reassigned two more times throughout the season and in seven D-League games, he averaged 20.3 points, 9.7 rebounds and 3.0 assists per game.{{cite web|title=Rockets recall Donatas Motiejunas from D-League again|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=12224|work=InsideHoops.com|date=January 28, 2013|access-date=January 28, 2013}} In 44 games for the Rockets, he averaged 5.7 points and 2.1 rebounds per game. ====2013–14 season==== On October 30, 2013, the Rockets exercised their third-year team option on Motiejūnas' rookie scale contract, extending the contract through the 2014–15 season.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Feigen|title=Rockets pick up options on Motiejunas, Jones|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2013/10/rockets-pick-up-options-on-motiejunas-jones/#17293101=0|work=Chron.com|date=October 30, 2013|access-date=October 30, 2013}} He went on to play 62 games for the Rockets while averaging 5.5 points and 3.6 rebounds per game. ====2014–15 season==== In August 2014, Motiejūnas came under fire for comments made about his Rocket teammates [[James Harden]] and [[Dwight Howard]], describing their relationship as "Hi & bye. They even eat separately from the team. Usually in some fast food place." The comments came in an interview with Lithuanian media.{{cite web|title=Rockets' Motiejunas misquoted about Harden, Howard not eating with team|url=https://www.si.com/nba/2014/08/08/james-harden-dwight-howard-eat-rockets|work=SI.com|date=August 8, 2014|access-date=August 8, 2014}} It was later revealed that Motiejūnas was misquoted in his comments due to an incorrect translation by Lithuanian media from Lithuanian to English.{{cite web|first=Dane|last=Carbaugh|title=Donatas Motiejunas sets record straight on Howard, Harden comments|url=http://www.sportingnews.com/nba-news/4601152-dwight-howard-james-harden-rockets-eat|work=SportingNews.com|date=August 8, 2014|access-date=August 8, 2014}}{{Dead link|date=February 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes}} On October 30, 2014, the Rockets exercised their fourth-year team option on Motiejūnas' rookie scale contract, extending the contract through the 2015–16 season.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Feigen|title=Rockets pick up fourth-year options on Terrence Jones, Donatas Motiejunas|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2014/10/rockets-pick-up-fourth-year-options-on-terrence-jones-donatas-motiejunas/|work=Chron.com|date=October 30, 2014|access-date=October 30, 2014}} With Dwight Howard out for a 11 games during November and December, and [[Terrence Jones]] out for the majority of the first half of the season, Motiejūnas averaged 14.3 points and 7.1 rebounds per game in Howard's 11-game absence.{{cite web|title=Donatas Motiejunas 2014-15 Game Log|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/m/motiedo01/gamelog/2015/|work=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=May 28, 2015}} After Howard's return on December 13, Motiejūnas scored a then career-high 25 points on 11-of-19 shooting to help the Rockets defeat the [[Denver Nuggets]] 108–96.{{cite web|title=Howard, Harden lead Rockets over Nuggets, 108-96|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20141213/DENHOU/gameinfo.html|work=NBA.com|date=December 14, 2014|access-date=December 14, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141228002806/http://www.nba.com/games/20141213/DENHOU/gameinfo.html|archive-date=December 28, 2014|url-status=dead}} On January 30, 2015, Motiejūnas scored a career-high 26 points in a 93–87 win over the [[Boston Celtics]].{{cite web|title=Motiejunas scores 26, Rockets top Celtics for 4th win in row|url=https://www.nba.com/games/20150130/HOUBOS/gameinfo.html|work=NBA.com|date=January 31, 2015|access-date=January 31, 2015}} On March 27, he was ruled out for one to two weeks with lower back pain and tightness.{{cite web|first=Jenny Dial|last=Creech|title=Rockets PF Donatas Motiejunas sidelined for 1-2 weeks with back pain|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2015/03/rockets-pf-donatas-motiejunas-sidelines-for-1-2-weeks-with-back-pain/|work=Chron.com|date=March 27, 2015|access-date=March 27, 2015}} However, the injury later ruled him out for the rest of the season,{{cite web|first=Calvin|last=Watkins|title=Houston Rockets lose Donatas Motiejunas for season with back injury|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/12648535/houston-rockets-lose-donatas-motiejunas-season-back-injury|work=ESPN.com|date=April 8, 2015|access-date=April 8, 2015}} and put his chances of playing for the Lithuanian national team in doubt.{{cite web|title=D.Motiejūno žaidimas Lietuvos rinktinėje pakibo ant plauko?|url=http://www.krepsinis.net/naujiena/d-motiejuno-zaidimas-lietuvos-rinktineje-pakibo-ant-plauko/249661|work=Krepsinis.net|date=April 9, 2015|access-date=April 9, 2015|language=lt-LT}} In his third NBA season, Motiejūnas led the league in post-up field goal percentage (53.4%), with his biggest competitor being fellow Lithuanian [[Jonas Valančiūnas]] of the [[Toronto Raptors]] (51.3%).{{cite web|title=Paaiškėjo statistinis rodiklis, pagal kurį abu lietuviai NBA neturėjo lygių|url=http://www.krepsinis.net/naujiena/paaiskejo-statistinis-rodiklis-pagal-kuri-abu-lietuviai-nba-neturejo-lygiu/249881|work=Krepsinis.net|date=April 16, 2015|access-date=April 16, 2015|language=lt-LT}} In recognition, Jonathan Feigen of the [[Houston Chronicle]] awarded Motiejūnas an "A" grade for his 2014–15 season performance.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Feigen|title=Rockets report card: Grading the 2014-15 roster|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2015/05/rockets-report-card-grading-the-2014-15-roster/|work=Chron.com|date=May 28, 2015|access-date=May 28, 2015}} ====2015–16 season==== On December 1, 2015, Motiejūnas was cleared to return to practice, having been out since March 2015 after requiring surgery to repair a herniated disk in his back.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Feigen|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2015/12/donatas-motiejunas-cleared-for-practice/|title=Donatas Motiejunas cleared for practice|work=Chron.com|date=December 1, 2015|access-date=December 1, 2015}} Four days later, he returned to the Rockets' lineup and made his season debut, earning a standing ovation when he entered the game for the first time during the first quarter of the team's 120–113 win over the [[Sacramento Kings]]. He had one rebound and took a charge in six minutes of play.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20151205/SACHOU/gameinfo.html|title=Harden's 31 help Rockets over Kings 120-113|work=NBA.com|date=December 6, 2015|access-date=December 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170403035201/http://www.nba.com/games/20151205/SACHOU/gameinfo.html|archive-date=April 3, 2017|url-status=dead}} He played in 14 straight games for the Rockets, including making one start, before more back pain forced him out again. He subsequently missed all of January's action, and on January 30, he was assigned to the Rio Grande Valley Vipers for the first time since 2013{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/fwd-rockets-assign-k-j-mcdaniels-and-donatas-motiejunas-to-rio-grande-valley/n-5095388|title=Fwd: Rockets Assign K.J. McDaniels and Donatas Motiejunas to Rio Grande Valley|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=January 30, 2016|access-date=January 30, 2016}} to complete his rehab from the back injury.{{cite web|last=Feigen|first=Jonathan|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2016/01/rockets-donatas-motiejunas-heading-to-d-league-in-next-step-of-rehab/|title=Rockets' Donatas Motiejunas heading to D-League in next step of rehab|work=Chron.com|date=January 29, 2016|access-date=January 30, 2016}} He later received two more assignments to the Vipers.{{cite web |url=http://dleague.nba.com/all-time-nba-assignments/ |title=All-Time NBA Assignments |work=NBA.com |access-date=December 15, 2016 |archive-date=March 22, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170322122733/http://dleague.nba.com/all-time-nba-assignments/ |url-status=dead}} On February 18, 2016, Motiejūnas and [[Marcus Thornton (basketball, born 1987)|Marcus Thornton]] were traded to the [[Detroit Pistons]] in a three-team trade involving the Rockets and the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-acquire-first-round-pick-three-way-trade-detroit-and-philadelphia|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160221223734/http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-acquire-first-round-pick-three-way-trade-detroit-and-philadelphia|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 21, 2016|title=Rockets Acquire First Round Pick in Three-Way Trade with Detroit and Philadelphia|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=February 18, 2016|access-date=February 18, 2016}} However, four days later, the Pistons [[Rescission (contract law)|rescinded]] their trade following a failed physical by Motiejūnas.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/pistons/news/detroit-pistons-rescind-trade-acquiring-forward-donatas-motiejunas-and-guard-marcus-thornton|title=Detroit Pistons Rescind Trade Acquiring Forward Donatas Motiejunas and Guard Marcus Thornton|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=February 22, 2016|access-date=February 22, 2016}}{{cite web|last=Watkins|first=Calvin|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/14825052/detroit-pistons-void-trade-houston-rockets-returning-donatas-motiejunas-marcus-thornton-joel-anthony-original-teams|title=Pistons void trade with Rockets when Donatas Motiejunas fails physical|work=ESPN.com|date=February 22, 2016|access-date=February 22, 2016}} On February 27, Motiejūnas returned to the Rockets' lineup and played for the first time since December 31.{{cite web|last=Feigen|first=Jonathan |url=http://www.chron.com/sports/rockets/article/Rockets-Donatas-Montiejunas-healthy-and-ready-to-6858130.php|title=Rockets' Donatas Montiejunas healthy and ready to play|work=Chron.com|date=February 27, 2016|access-date=February 27, 2016}} The Rockets finished the [[2015–16 NBA season|2015–16 regular season]] as the eighth seed in the Western Conference with a 41–41 record. In the first round of the [[2016 NBA playoffs|2016 playoffs]], the Rockets faced the first-seeded [[Golden State Warriors]], and in a game 3 win on April 21, Motiejūnas recorded 14 points and 13 rebounds for his first career double-double in the postseason.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20160421/GSWHOU/gameinfo.html|title=Harden's late shot lifts Rockets over Warriors 97-96|date=April 21, 2016|work=NBA.com|access-date=April 22, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160421114745/http://www.nba.com/games/20160421/GSWHOU/gameinfo.html|archive-date=April 21, 2016|url-status=dead}} ===New Orleans Pelicans (2017)=== After the 2015–16 season, Motiejūnas became a [[restricted free agent (NBA)|restricted free agent]]. On December 2, 2016, following a prolonged contract dispute with the Rockets that lasted into the first month of the 2016–17 season, he received a four-year, $37 million offer sheet from the [[Brooklyn Nets]],{{cite web|last=Blinebury|first=Fran|url=https://www.nba.com/article/2016/12/02/brooklyn-nets-sign-donatas-motiejunas-offer-sheet|title=Report: Brooklyn Nets sign Donatas Motiejunas to offer sheet|work=NBA.com|date=December 2, 2016|access-date=December 3, 2016}} which the Rockets matched three days later.{{cite web|last=Wojnarowski|first=Adrian|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources-houston-matches-nets-offer-sheet-for-donatas-motiejunas-221704984.html|title=Sources: Houston matches Nets' offer sheet for Donatas Motiejunas|work=Yahoo.com|date=December 5, 2016|access-date=December 5, 2016}} A day after the Rockets matched his four-year offer sheet to retain him, Motiejūnas did not show up for his scheduled physical exam with the team.{{cite web|last=Feigen|first=Jonathan|url=http://www.chron.com/sports/rockets/article/Rockets-Donatas-Motiejunas-fails-to-show-up-for-10759626.php|title=Rockets' Donatas Motiejunas fails to show up for physical|work=Chron.com|date=December 6, 2016|access-date=December 6, 2016}} Motiejūnas' camp made the decision to not report to the Rockets because of a difference of nearly $6 million from the offer sheet he signed with the Nets; the Rockets only had to match the principle terms of the offer sheet, which came to $31 million.{{cite web|last=Watkins|first=Calvin|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/18227996/donatas-motiejunas-report-houston-rockets-6-million-difference-offer-sheet|title=Donatas Motiejunas won't report to Rockets over $6M difference from Nets' offer sheet|work=ESPN.com|date=December 8, 2016|access-date=December 9, 2016}} As a result, on December 9, the two sides negotiated a new four-year, partially guaranteed deal worth between $35 million and $37 million with bonus clauses.{{cite web|last=Wojnarowski|first=Adrian|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources-donatas-motiejunas-agrees-to-new-deal-with-rockets-165145947.html|title=Sources: Donatas Motiejunas agrees to new deal with Rockets|work=Yahoo.com|date=December 9, 2016|access-date=December 9, 2016}} While they appeared to have a new deal in place, Motiejūnas was sent home before the team's game on December 10 after taking a physical,{{cite web|last=Feigen|first=Jonathan|url=http://www.chron.com/sports/rockets/article/Rockets-Donatas-Motiejunas-saga-now-involves-the-10792015.php|title=Rockets, Donatas Motiejunas saga now involves the NBA|work=Chron.com|date=December 12, 2016|access-date=December 15, 2016}} and five days later, the Rockets renounced the four-year deal and their rights to Motiejūnas, allowing him to become an unrestricted free agent.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-match-nets-offer-sheet-restricted-free-agent-donatas-motiejunas|title=Rockets Statement on Donatas Motiejunas|work=NBA.com|date=December 15, 2016|access-date=December 15, 2016}} On January 3, 2017, Motiejūnas signed with the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-sign-donatas-motiejunas|title=Pelicans Sign Donatas Motiejunas|work=NBA.com|date=January 3, 2017|access-date=January 3, 2017}} He made his debut for the Pelicans four days later, recording 11 points and five rebounds in 20 minutes off the bench in a 117–108 loss to the Boston Celtics.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400899974|title=Thomas, Smart power Celtics past Pelicans, 117-108|work=ESPN.com|date=January 7, 2017|access-date=January 7, 2017}} An unexpected trade during the All-Star break for [[DeMarcus Cousins]] led to a diminishing role for Motiejūnas. He initially appeared in 21 consecutive games after signing with New Orleans, but from February 25 through April 4, he did not play in 11 out of a 20-game span.{{cite web|last=Eichenhofer|first=Jim|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/2016-17-pelicans-season-review-donatas-motiejunas/|title=2016-17 Pelicans Season Review: Donatas Motiejunas|work=NBA.com|date=May 17, 2017|access-date=July 3, 2017}} ===Shandong Golden Stars (2017–2019)=== On August 9, 2017, Motiejūnas signed a one-year, $2.2 million contract with the [[Shandong Golden Stars]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]] (CBA).{{cite web|author=David Pick|url=https://twitter.com/IAmDPick/status/895292459265257474|title=China's Shandong announce the signings of...|work=Twitter|date=August 9, 2017|access-date=August 9, 2017}} It was reported that he was the highest-paid foreigner of the whole league.{{cite web|title=Milžiniški lūkesčiai: D. Motiejūnas – Kinijoje brangiausiai apmokamas legionierius|url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/milziniski-lukesciai-d-motiejunas-kinijoje-brangiausiai-apmokamas-legionierius.d?id=75901981|website=Krepsinis.lt|access-date=September 28, 2017}} On February 1, 2018, Motiejūnas recorded a [[Double (basketball)#Triple-double|triple-double]] leading his team to an important 127–103 victory versus the [[Jiangsu Dragons]] by recording 29 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists.{{cite web|title=Kinijoje – galingas D.Motiejūno trigubas dublis ir individualūs šou|url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/kinijoje-galingas-d-motiejuno-trigubas-dublis-ir-individualus-sou-875-919580|website=24sek.lt|access-date=February 1, 2018}} On March 13, Motiejūnas began the [[2018 CBA Playoffs]] with 24 points, seven rebounds and a 104–100 victory versus the Jiangsu Dragons.{{cite web|title=Rezultatyvus Donatas Motiejūnas atkrintamąsias pradėjo pergale|url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/rezultatyvus-donatas-motiejunas-atkrintamasias-pradejo-pergale-875-939856|website=15min.lt/24sek|access-date=March 13, 2018}} His team defeated Jiangsu Dragons 3–0 in the first round after their third 127–104 victory during which Motiejūnas scored 29 points and grabbed 13 rebounds.{{cite web|title=Rezultatyviausiai žaidęs Motiejūnas nutiesė savo komandai kelią į Kinijos pirmenybių pusfinalį|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-118978-rezultatyviausiai-zaides-motiejunas-nutiese-savo-komandai-kelia-i-kinijos-pirmenybiu-pusfinali.html|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=March 18, 2018|language=lt-LT}} In the semifinals, they faced the [[Zhejiang Lions]], which offered a much higher competition. His team tied the series 2–2 after Motiejūnas' solid contribution of 35 points (a career-high in China) and 14 rebounds versus his direct opponent [[Ioannis Bourousis]].{{cite web|title=Rezultatyviausias rungtynes sužaidęs Donatas Motiejūnas išgelbėjo komandos sezoną|url=https://www.tv3.lt/naujiena/953263/rezultatyviausias-rungtynes-suzaides-donatas-motiejunas-isgelbejo-komandos-sezona|website=tv3.lt|access-date=April 4, 2018}} Despite his yet another good performance of 31 points, 13 rebounds, two blocks and one assist, his team was eliminated in the series 4–3 after an 105–95 loss in game 7.{{cite web|title=Motiejūno sezonas Kinijoje baigtas įspūdingu pasirodymu|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-119695-motiejuno-sezonas-kinijoje-baigtas-ispudingu-pasirodymu.html|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=April 11, 2018|language=lt-LT}} On November 8, 2018, Motiejūnas achieved his career rebounds record by grabbing 25 rebounds and scoring 24 points that led his team to a 100–82 victory versus the Jiangsu Dragons.{{cite web |title=Fantastiškai dėl kamuolių kovojęs Motiejūnas pagerino asmeninį rekordą |url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/fantastiskai-del-kamuoliu-kovojes-motiejunas-pagerino-asmenini-rekorda.d?id=79533103 |website=[[DELFI]] |access-date=November 8, 2018}} Less than a week later, on November 13, he improved his rebounds record once again by scoring 32 points and grabbing 32 rebounds, while his team defeated the [[Shanghai Sharks]] 99–96.{{cite web |title=Neeilinis Motiejūno vakaras – sugriebęs 32 kamuolius pagerino asmeninį rekordą |url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/neeilinis-motiejuno-vakaras-sugriebes-32-kamuolius-pagerino-asmenini-rekorda.d?id=79575093 |website=[[DELFI]] |access-date=November 13, 2018}} On March 3, 2019, Motiejūnas scored a career-high 43 points, along with 17 rebounds and six assists, and led his team to an 122–83 victory.{{cite web |title=Fantastiškai pasirodęs Donatas Motiejūnas pasiekė savo taškų rekordą |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/lietuva/fantastiskai-pasirodes-donatas-motiejunas-pasieke-savo-tasku-rekorda-875-1110768 |website=15min.lt/24sek |access-date=March 3, 2019}} Despite a good [[2018–19 CBA season|2018–19 regular season]], during which he averaged 27.3 points, 14 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 1.8 steals, his team was eliminated in the first round of the [[2019 CBA Playoffs]], after losing 113–105 to the Jiangsu Dragons on March 20.{{cite web |title=Donato Motiejūno sezonas Kinijoje baigėsi aštuntfinalyje |url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-128515-donato-motiejuno-sezonas-kinijoje-baigesi-astuntfinalyje.html |website=BasketNews.lt |access-date=March 20, 2019 |language=lt-LT}} ===San Antonio Spurs (2019)=== On April 4, 2019, Motiejūnas signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{cite web |title=Spurs sign Donatas Motiejunas |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-donatas-motiejunas |website=San Antonio Spurs |access-date=April 5, 2019 |publisher=NBA.com |date=April 4, 2019}} He declined to sign a new contract with the Spurs because China's [[Shanghai Sharks]] offered a more valuable deal.{{cite web |title=Pakeliui į Kiniją D.Motiejūnas atmetė viliojančius NBA ir Eurolygos turčių pasiūlymus |language=lt-LT}} ===Shanghai Sharks (2019–2020)=== On August 27, 2019, Motiejūnas signed a $6 million contract with CBA's [[Shanghai Sharks]].{{cite web |title=Oficialu: Motiejūnas pasirašė sutartį su naujuoju klubu |url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/oficialu-motiejunas-pasirase-sutarti-su-naujuoju-klubu.d?id=82079869 |website=[[Delfi.lt]] |access-date=August 27, 2019}} On June 9, games|url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-06/09/c_139126230.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210818232617/http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-06/09/c_139126230.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 18, 2021|date=June 9, 2020|website=xinhuanet.com|access-date=June 9, 2020}} In 28 games during the [[2019–20 Chinese Basketball Association season|2019–20 season]], he averaged 22.8 points, a league-leading 15.1 rebounds, 3.5 assists, 1.8 steals and 0.5 blocks per game in 36.7 minutes of average playing time.{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/international/players/donatas-motiejunas-1.html|title=Donatas Motiejunas International Stats|website=[[Basketball-Reference.com]]|access-date=July 17, |language=fr-FR |date=August 18, 2021}} On July 21, 2023, he renewed his contract with Monaco through 2025.{{cite web |title=Susitarė: Motiejūnas pratęsė sutartį su "Monaco" klubu March 2026}} ==National team career== [[File:Donatas Motiejūnas with Lithuania men's national basketball team in 2023.jpg|thumb|150px|Motiejūnas with the Lithuania men's national basketball team in 2023]] Motiejūnas represented Lithuania's national teams in international tournaments. Motiejūnas led [[Lithuania men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|Lithuania under-18 team]] to the silver medal at the [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2008 FIBA U18 European Championship]]. Despite losing to [[Greece men's national under-19 basketball team|Greece]] in the gold medal game, he was named the [[most valuable player]] (MVP) of the tournament, after averaging 18.2 points, 10.2 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per game.{{cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2008.coid_cD5xud6oJzsBclDqjuNWQ0.articleMode_on.html|title=MOTIEJUNAS MVP, TWO GREEKS IN ALL-TOURNAMENT TEAM|work=FIBAEurope.com|date=August 3, 2008|access-date=August 3, 2008}} At the [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship|2008 FIBA U20 European Championship]], he averaged 11.2 points and 5.4 rebounds per game.{{cite web|url=http://turkey2010.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/57836/pid2//sid/6074/tid/2135/tid2//_/2008_U20_European_Championship_Men_DIVISION_A/index.html|archive-url=https://wayback.archive-it.org/all/20120802213403/http://turkey2010.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/57836/pid2//sid/6074/tid/2135/tid2//_/2008_U20_European_Championship_Men_DIVISION_A/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 2, 2012|title=Donatas Motiejunas's profile – FIBA.com|work=FIBA.com|access-date=June 16, 2015}} Motiejūnas won a silver medal with [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuania senior team]] at [[EuroBasket 2013]] tournament and went on to compete for the national team at the [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup]], where he averaged 7.4 points and 4.0 rebounds in nine games.{{cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2014/player/Donatas-Motiejunas|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191203180830/http://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2014/player/Donatas-Motiejunas|url-status=live|archive-date=December 3, 2019|title=2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup – Donatas MOTIEJUNAS|work=FIBA.com|access-date=June 16, 2015}} In June 2015, Motiejūnas ruled himself out of [[EuroBasket 2015]] to continue recovering from a back injury he sustained while playing for the Houston Rockets.{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/national-teams/national-teams/164189/donatas-motiejunas-says-he-will-not-play-at-eurobasket-2015.html|title=Donatas Motiejunas says he will not play at Eurobasket 2015|work=Sportando.com|date=June 16, 2015|access-date=June 16, 2015}} ==Personal life== Motiejūnas has a large tattoo on his chest of an eagle clutching a basketball. He explained, "I really like the attitudes of eagles. They never give up. When they grab a fish or something else, they never let it go."{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/gallery/machado_motiejunas_2.html|title=Rockets Assign Duo to NBA D-League|work=NBA.com|access-date=January 29, 2016}}{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZB7jENn5Sco |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211221/ZB7jENn5Sco |archive-date=December 21, 2021 |url-status=live|title=Donatas Motiejūnas Houston Rockets Talk|work=Youtube.com|date=June 24, 2011|access-date=June 24, 2011}}{{cbignore}} Motiejūnas is a fan of [[FC Bayern Munich]] and [[Germany national football team]].{{cite web|title=D.Motiejūnas – apie sunkią NBA kelionę, rinktinę, D.Sabonio potencialą ir žinutę vaikams|url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/amerika/d-motiejunas-apie-sunkia-nba-kelione-rinktine-d-sabonio-potenciala-ir-zinute-vaikams-873-654633|website=24sek.lt|access-date=July 13, 2016}}
